name: mel-logging
title: Adopt Microsoft.Extensions.Logging with source-generated log messages
description: Replace the hand-rolled IRuntimeLogger/ConsoleRuntimeLogger with Microsoft.Extensions.Logging: ILogger everywhere, [LoggerMessage] source-generated methods for every log site (no manual IsEnabled guards), a testable single-line stderr console provider, more info-level lifecycle logging, and updated specs/tests/benchmarks.
creator: qmazon
